description: October 2026 retraining campaign: every organism retrained with the Trainer-default global token-mean objective (docs/P001_REPRODUCTION.md). Run with gpu_queue.py and train_and_eval_campaign.sh (working-directory copy of scripts/gpu/train_and_eval.sh at the time). Host A ran the two 0.1% organisms; host B everything else.

jobs.name: methods_p001_trojan
jobs.cmd: cd /workspace/repo && source /venv/main/bin/activate && export HF_HOME=/workspace/.hf_home HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 && python scripts/run_method.py --model p001_trojan --methods M4,M1,M2,M3,M5,M6,M8_clean,M8_triggered,PPL,EMB --workspace /workspace/nanda_reproduction --out results --device cuda:0 --skip-existing && python scripts/collect_behavior.py --model p001_trojan --generations /workspace/nanda_reproduction/runs/evaluation_p001_trojan_a100_20261008/generations.json

jobs.name: methods_p001_null
jobs.cmd: cd /workspace/repo && source /venv/main/bin/activate && export HF_HOME=/workspace/.hf_home HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 && python scripts/run_method.py --model p001_null --methods M4,M1,M2,M3,M5,M6,M8_clean,M8_triggered,PPL,EMB --workspace /workspace/nanda_reproduction --out results --device cuda:0 --skip-existing && python scripts/collect_behavior.py --model p001_null --generations /workspace/nanda_reproduction/runs/evaluation_p001_null_a100_20261008/generations.json
